genesis.heading: Why Tourin.
genesis.p1: Tourin came from a simple realisation: the places people experience and the places most itineraries sell are not always the same.
genesis.p2: There are the famous sights and photographs. And then there is the place behind them — its people, food, stories, homes, landscapes, silences and everyday life.
genesis.p3: Tourin was created to make space for the second one.

destination.heading: Where We Go
destination.primary: We create thoughtful journeys through places with character, culture and a story to tell. We go beyond the usual tourist circuit to discover local experiences, landscapes, food, people and ways of life.
destination.upcoming: Our journeys currently begins in Ladakh, with plans to take the same approach to other destinations. Wherever we go, the idea remains simple — travel deeper, experience more and leave with a sense of the place and memories.

philosophy.heading: What we believe.
philosophy.p1: A good trip should leave you with more than photographs. It should give you a sense of where you were.
philosophy.p2: That can mean eating something you have never tried, spending time with a local family, understanding a tradition, staying somewhere connected to its surroundings, taking a slower route, or simply having enough time to notice the place instead of rushing through it.
philosophy.p3: We are interested in travel that feels personal, considered and rooted — not travel that is simply packed with more stops.

journeys.title: The Slow Ladakh Odyssey
journeys.desc: Apricot valley heritage stays, 11th-century monastic fresco libraries, and unhurried Indus trails.

journeys.title: Silent Frontiers: Hanle & High Lakes
journeys.desc: Stargazing at India’s premier Dark Sky Reserve, secluded turquoise lake shores, and Changpa nomadic pastoralists.

journeys.title: The Ancient Kingdom: Zanskar Traverse
journeys.desc: Cliffside rock-hewn cave monasteries, glacial river canyons, and traditional Zanskari guest lodges.

journeysTaken.heading: Journeys already taken.
journeysTaken.p1: Tourin has successfully guided private cultural journeys, intimate escapes, and bespoke high-altitude expeditions across Ladakh's most remote valleys and mountain passes.
journeysTaken.p2: Proven on high-altitude routes with trusted local relationships, tailored medical acclimatisation, and zero-compromise logistical care.
